notes.title: Game Game is now only $0.90!
notes.notes:
After nearly a year on Steam, Gun Game will now be heavily discounted going forward. The main reason for the price drop is because we have always wanted this game to be accessible to as many people as possible, and if it were possible to make it free, we would also do that! We regret that we didn't do this sooner for the people who already bought the game for $5, and we want to make it clear how much we appreciate that support. Thank you for supporting Gun Game! Without the support, encouragement, and feedback that we've received, good and bad, we never would have made it this far. That's not to say this is where Gun Game stops though. We have more things planned, and hopefully we can create something worth much more than those 90 cents! 
- Fireround
